name: One Night Ultimate Super Villains
summary: One-night social deduction where hidden heroes try to catch hidden villains after a chaotic night of role-swapping powers.
rules_text: Place one role card per player plus three center cards plus one extra if Temptress is in play. Shuffle and deal one facedown to each player; remaining three go to center unseen. Players secretly view own card. At night in fixed app order, roles wake to act: villains see each other; Temptress gives an extra villain card to a non-villain swapping with center; Dr. Peeker peeks a player's card; Rapscallion peeks a center card; others like Detector, Voodoo Lou, Role Retriever, Switcheroo, Flipper, Mirror Man look or swap cards as described. Swapped players keep original night actions but become new team. By day all close eyes, then discuss openly and vote simultaneously to catch villains. If a villain is voted out heroes win, unless Mad Scientist is also caught, then Mad Team wins; if no villain caught and Mad Scientist not in game heroes lose.
